name: Meeting Recorder
tagline: Your agent joins the call, records it, and gives you the notes, the decisions and the follow-ups afterwards.
who: Anyone who runs more calls than they can write up: founders, sellers and managers who lose a decision because nobody was taking notes.
how:
Give your agent the meeting link and the time. Then:

- It checks in advance that it can get in, while there is still time to fix a problem. If the service needs a sign-in, it asks you to take over the shared browser once.
- At the meeting it joins muted and says in the chat that it is recording.
- It turns on the platform's live captions and keeps both the audio and the transcript.

Afterwards you get the notes, the decisions, and the action items filed as tasks. It handles Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex directly, and works the rest out from the join page.
